links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified online breast reconstruction patient education texts
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid grade level, Gunning Fog, Coleman-Liau) and PEMAT understandability/actionability
links.effect: Mean FK grade 11.2 to 8.6, Gunning Fog 13.9 to 10.5, Coleman-Liau 11.3 to 9.7 (all p < 0.001); PEMAT understandability 0.70 vs 0.58 (p < 0.001); actionability 0.40 vs 0.37 (p = 0.057)
links.tradeoff: AI-translated texts still averaged above the 6th-grade target; actionability gain was not statistically significant. Accuracy/completeness of the simplified text was not reported.
links.quote: The mean Flesch-Kincaid grade level, the Gunning Fog index, and the Coleman-Liau index for the AI-translated counterparts were 8.6, 10.5, and 9.7 (all p < 0.001).

links.comparator_used: Original online texts (no 6th-grade instruction); no default-prompt arm was tested
links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT 4.0 output when instructed to target 6th-grade level
links.effect: Mean FK grade 11.2 to 8.6, Gunning Fog 13.9 to 10.5, Coleman-Liau 11.3 to 9.7 (all p < 0.001); output did not reach the 6th-grade target
links.tradeoff: Target grade level was not achieved; outputs remained at roughly 8.6-10.5 grade level.
links.quote: ChatGPT 4.0 was instructed to translate the individual texts to the 6th-grade level of English comprehension, and the readability of the translated texts was analyzed.

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompt for patient education materials
